stance_rationale: Nominal IC gates pass, but the package is not a valid alpha handoff because PIT dating, mandated universe enforcement, loader discipline, and AX-008 lineage are broken or unverifiable. The most damaging issue is that month-start alpha dates are built from month-end factor files, including factor_db_202401 dated 2024-01-31 while claiming signal_as_of 2024-01-01 and lockbox isolation.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: RF-A7 is not triggered: alpha_scores.parquet has 241 regular monthly dates and no future dates. However, only 116179 of 329700 rows have non-null score_eff, A-stage artifacts are absent, and the month-start Date labels are sourced from month-end factor_db files.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern was found; final score construction uses align_factor_direction-derived aligned z-scores.
factor_db_202401.parquet has Date=2024-01-31 but is assigned sig_date=2024-01-01; factor_db files lack Usable_Date, so Usable_Date <= sig_date is not evidenced.
factor_engine_proposal.R bulk-reads .cache/factor_db/factor_db_*.parquet directly and only spot-checks one month against load_month_factors().
Alpha attaches regime_state from the Iter 2 regime_panel and does not decide cash weights; same-day overlay is not the primary blocker.
Q07/Q25 lag compliance is asserted through Factor DB, but the direct parquet path has no Usable_Date field and includes the 2024-01-31 factor file in the claimed train window.

critical_concerns.description: The engine labels factor_db_YYYYMM files as YYYY-MM-01 signals, but the underlying factor Date is month-end; factor_db_202401 Date=2024-01-31 is included despite TRAIN_END=2024-01-22 and lockbox start=2024-01-23.
C15 requires load_month_factors(); this package bulk-reads factor_db_*.parquet and rationalizes equivalence with a single Q07 spot-check, bypassing the mandated harness path.
Latest valid alpha universe has 693 names but only 259 are in KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 on the nearest raw-data date; only 11 of the top 20 alpha names pass K200/KQ150 membership.
Subperiod stability is 0.3285 versus the 0.50 gate, with IC decaying from 0.0720 to 0.0236 across subperiods; this is a hard alpha robustness failure.
The selected blend ICIR 0.5654 is below the core sleeve ICIR 0.5660 and package blend_vs_best_single is -0.0011; method log also shows an unselected 0.80/0.20 blend with higher ICIR 0.5849.
The reported Harvey statistic is a simple IC t-stat; no Newey-West HAC portfolio regression across CAPM, Carhart, FF5, and FF6 specs is provided, and FF5 validation is deferred to Forge/Judge.

challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and the requested A-stage artifact directory are absent; the available run log predates the package and ends in an error.

Sector-neutral IC is not reported, post_neutralization_ic is only liquidity-neutral, time-series TDC is NaN, and cross-section Jaccard versus Iter 3 is 0.739, leaving L-219 family saturation unresolved.
The package invokes multi-sleeve and defense EXCLUSION language, but no Gate13 portfolio translation, weights schedule, cash overlay behavior, turnover, or covariance evidence is available.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 is not triggered: alpha_scores.parquet has 241 monthly sig_dates, month-start spacing, and max Date 2024-01-01 <= today.
RF-A3 is not triggered: recent 3Y ICIR is approximately 0.2495, only 0.44x the full ICIR.
RF-A5 direct illiquidity is not triggered for the latest top 20: audited minimum lagged AvgTV20 is about 231.9m KRW, above the 2e8 hard floor.
Aggregate decile returns are monotone, but the package reports monotonicity as NA and monthly adjacent decile monotonicity is only about 0.532.
unresolved_disputes: Whether rank_IC and ICIR survive after re-dating signals to actual usable dates and excluding all lockbox-contaminated observations.
Whether metrics survive after enforcing KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 before ranking and alpha_vector generation.
Whether 0.65/0.35 was selected for a reason other than ICIR, since the package states selection_objective=icir while a higher-ICIR candidate exists.
Whether DSR=0.5648 is reproducible from a clean successful run log and from the intended Bailey-Lopez de Prado calculation.
Whether weights.csv schedule, turnover <600%, covariance PSD, and condition number <=100 can pass; required files are absent.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that the 2004-2024 month-start alpha panel is PIT-safe, even though it is built from month-end factor_db files and includes a 2024-01-31 factor snapshot inside the sealed lockbox while labeling it as 2024-01-01.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate alpha_scores via load_month_factors() for every sig_date or provide equivalent harness-level proof with actual Usable_Date <= sig_date evidence.
Re-date signals to the actual usable/rebalance calendar and remove all lockbox-contaminated factor and forward-return observations.
Apply KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 membership before score ranking and regenerate alpha_vector, diagnostics, and top-20 evidence.
Explain why Blend_065_035 was selected under selection_objective=icir despite higher-ICIR candidates, or change the stated objective.
Provide challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, clean run log, 5-spec HAC regression, DSR reproduction, sector-neutral IC, PG2 crowding TDC, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Only alpha_package_draft.json and B-stage alpha artifacts were available. The requested A-stage artifacts, three-agent packages, challenge notes, weights, covariance, and lineage evidence were missing, so AX-008 cannot pass.

alpha_specific_questions: After correcting month-end factor dating and lockbox contamination, does rank_IC remain >=0.04 and ICIR remain >=0.20?
After enforcing KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150, how many of the current top 20 survive and what is the regenerated alpha_vector?
Why is 0.65/0.35 selected when method_shopping_log reports higher ICIR for another blend?
